metadata.purpose: BOMATIC SS2 BoM Construction reference data for items previously marked MISSING

fx_rates.description: Currency reference for BOMATIC pricing engine. Pegged currencies are static; floating currencies need periodic refresh.

EGP.notes: Floated 2022. ~14.07 SAR per EGP. Update monthly minimum.

TRY.notes: ~11.02 SAR per TRY. Depreciating. Update weekly for active bids.

KWD.notes: Pegged to basket but floats slightly.

fx_rates.bomatic_implementation: Pegged rates can be hardcoded as constants. Floating rates need a manual input field for month 1. Future: API feed from exchangeratesapi.io or similar.

power_cords.description: Country-specific power cord SKU mapping for Cisco equipment. Saudi Arabia uses BS 1363 Type G (same as UK).

AC Power Cord UK Right Angle, BS 1363 to C13, 2.5m

KSA_UAE_GCC.notes: Saudi Arabia uses BS 1363 (Type G) — identical to UK. All GCC countries (UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait) also use Type G.

fortinet_power_cords.notes: Fortinet appliances ship with country-specific cords based on order region. SKU suffix indicates region: -USG (US), -EU (Europe), -UK (UK/GCC). For KSA/GCC, order with -UK suffix or specify BS 1363 at PO.

power_cords.bomatic_implementation: Auto-select power cord SKU based on country field in project. Default for KSA/GCC = BS 1363 Type G (UK variants). Add 2 per device (redundant PSU).

rack_rails_mounting.description: Rack mounting hardware is typically included with Cisco equipment orders. Additional rails/mounting kits are ordered separately when needed.

cisco_common_skus.description: UCS C-Series M6 ball-bearing rail kit

rack_rails_mounting.notes: Most Cisco devices include basic rack ears in the box. Rail kits for servers (UCS) and high-end switches (Nexus) are separate SKUs. Fortinet appliances include rack ears in box for all rackmount models.
rack_rails_mounting.bomatic_implementation: Auto-add rack mount kit SKU per device if not included in base config. Flag when device needs 4-post rails vs 2-post ears.

eol_eos_data_sources.description: How BOMATIC should check End-of-Life / End-of-Sale status for proposed equipment.

api.name: Cisco EoX API (Support APIs)
capabilities: Query by Product ID (SKU) — returns all EoL milestones
Query by date range — returns all products with EoL announcements in range
Query by software release — returns EoL dates for OS versions
Returns: EndOfSaleDate, EndOfSWMaintenance, EndOfSecurityVulSupport, LastDateOfSupport, EndOfServiceContractRenewal
api.implementation: Integrate via NTT's Cisco API access. Query each SKU in generated BoM against EoX API. Flag any device past EndOfSale or approaching LastDateOfSupport.

manual_fallback.notes: Full listing of all EoL/EoS notices by product category. Scrape monthly for offline DB.

fortinet.notes: Fortinet publishes EoL notices per product family. No public API. Scrape or manual check monthly.
fortinet.implementation: Build a static lookup table of current FortiGate/FortiSwitch/FortiAP model lifecycle status. Update monthly.

eol_eos_data_sources.bomatic_implementation: For month 1: static lookup table for common models. Phase 2: integrate Cisco EoX API for real-time validation.

cisco.notes: Check feature support by platform + IOS version. No public API — cache results for common platforms.

fortinet.notes: FortiOS compatibility matrix published per major release. Check FortiGate + FortiSwitch + FortiAP interop.

vendor_compatibility.bomatic_implementation: Month 1: hardcode compatibility rules for top 20 most-ordered models per vendor. Expand as needed.

accessory_matrices.description: PSU, fan, and rail requirements per device model.

cisco_pattern.notes: Cisco CCW (Commerce Workspace) generates accessory requirements automatically during configuration. For BOMATIC month 1, hardcode the top 20 Catalyst/ISR/Firepower models.

fortinet_pattern.notes: Fortinet appliances ship with PSU and fans included. Redundant PSU is a separate SKU for high-availability models.

accessory_matrices.bomatic_implementation: Build accessory lookup table: model -> [required_accessories]. Start with top 20 models per vendor. Expand from BoM corpus (we have 58 BoM files showing real accessory selections).
